question.en: Can you change the lens, or its focal length?
question.zh-cn: 能换镜头吗？能改变焦距吗？

summary.en: Lens attachment and focal-length range are separate questions.
summary.zh-cn: 镜头连接方式与焦距变化范围是两个问题。

boundary.en: Fixed-lens means built into the camera; prime means one focal length. Neither means fixed focus. Mount compatibility and image-circle coverage also need separate checks.
boundary.zh-cn: 固定镜头表示镜头与机身一体，定焦表示只有一个焦距，都不等于固定焦点。卡口兼容与成像圈覆盖也需要分别检查。

en: A built-in lens and an interchangeable lens can each be prime or zoom. GFX100RF illustrates the first combination: a built-in single-focal-length lens, not a body accepting GF lenses. Separately check whether a lens mount works mechanically and electronically, and whether its image circle covers the recording area.
zh-cn: 一体式镜头与可换镜头都可以是定焦或变焦。GFX100RF 使用一体式定焦镜头，不能换装 GF 镜头。还要分别检查镜头卡口的机械和电子兼容性，以及成像圈能否覆盖记录区域。
